items.t: Who will you learn from in 6 days at TechCrunch Founder Summit? Meet the founders and investors taking the stages
items.d: Six days from now, TechCrunch Founder Summit brings experienced founders, investors, and operators to Boston on Nov. 4 to share the decisions, mistakes, pivots, and lessons that shaped their companies. Register before it starts for ticket savings and deals.
items.fullText: There are plenty of places to find startup advice. TechCrunch Founder Summit is about hearing what happened when people actually put that advice to the test. Six days from now, TechCrunch Founder Summit , presented by Fidelity Private Shares , brings experienced founders, investors, and operators to Boston to share the decisions, mistakes, pivots, and lessons that shaped their companies. Register now to save up to $100 , get a second ticket free when you buy one, or save up to 30% on group ticket bundles. Don’t miss these deals before the event starts on November 4. Who and what are on the agenda Explore the full Founder Summit agenda to discover the breakout and roundtable sessions and speakers bringing actionable insights, hard-earned lessons, and practical advice to help you scale your startup. Image Credits: Halo Creative / Flickr (opens in a new window) From Boston startup to public company Few stories capture the potential of the Boston startup ecosystem better than Toast . Steve Fredette , president, co-founder, and director of Toast, will talk about what it takes to keep reinventing a company even after the original idea works. Scaling creates a new set of questions: How do you keep innovating? How do you stay close to the customers who got you there? And how do you evolve as technology and expectations change around you? For founders trying to move from early traction toward meaningful scale, those are the questions that matter. Know whether you’re actually ready to grow Growth can be exciting. Premature growth can be expensive. Kent Bennett, Partner at Bessemer Venture Partners , will explore how founders can recognize meaningful product-market fit before they scale. Rudina Seseri , Founder and Managing Partner of Glasswing Ventures , will take that conversation further by tackling when founders should accelerate and when hitting the brakes may be the smarter decision. items.t: US Economy Grows a Faster-Than-Expected 3.4%, Most in a Year
items.d: The US economy expanded in the third quarter at the fastest pace in a year, supercharged by feverish business investment and a resilient American consumer.

items.t: 삼성SDI, 3분기 영업이익 4078억 원…ESS 판매 확대에 흑자전환
items.d: 삼성SDI는 인공지능(AI) 데이터센터 성장에 따른 에너지저장장치(ESS)와 배터리백업유닛(BBU) 수요 증가, 전기차용 배터리 판매 확대 등에 힘입어 올해 3분기 흑자 전환에 성공했다고 29일 밝혔다.삼성SDI의 3분기 연결 기준 매출은 4조 6856억 원, 영업이익은 4078억 원으로 집계됐다. 매출은 전년 동기 대비 52.6% 증가했으며 영업이익은 지난해 같은 기간 5913억 원 적자에서 흑자로 전환했다.전 분기와 비교하면 매출은 20.9%, 영업이익은 100.1% 증가했다. 영업이익률은 8.7%로 전 분기 5.3%보다 3.4%포인트 상승했다. 당기순이익은 3422억 원을 기록했다.삼성SDI는 AI 데이터센터 투자 확대에 따라 ESS와 BBU용 배터리 판매가 증가한 것이 실적 개선에 기여했다고 설명했다

items.t: As AI agents reshape the web, Google opens Gemini and Search to more apps
items.d: A new developer platform will let businesses bring their services to Google's AI experiences, potentially changing how consumers discover and use apps.
items.fullText: Google is making it easier for businesses to connect their apps to its AI experiences across Search and Gemini with the debut of its Connected Apps Platform. Introduced in Gemini and Google Search earlier this year, connected apps let users securely link and interact with popular third-party services, then use them to take specific actions. For instance, you could connect to Canva to design a flyer, or to YouTube Music to build a playlist. We’ve seen varying takes on the idea by other consumer-facing AI services like ChatGPT and Meta’s Muse. The premise is that such integrations could ultimately shift consumer behavior away from launching and using individual apps to instead using their favorite services through their preferred AI provider. However, to successfully capture and retain consumers’ attention, there have to actually be a wide range of connected apps to explore. Google’s idea is to open its doors to any business or developer that wants to reach users through Search or Gemini by allowing them to submit their own connected apps and monitor their performance. The platform preview is currently available in beta to developers in the U.S., and will allow developers to build and submit apps that can be used across Google’s products. To get started, developers would integrate with a cloud-hosted MCP (Model Context Protocol) server or Android MCP using the AppFunctions APIs, then use the Google Connected Console to register, test, and submit their app, Google explains. Essentially, this process lets devs connect their app to Google’s services so it can be used with the search giant’s AI features. Developers can also choose whether they want their app to be available via Search, the Gemini app, or both. After the app is live, developers can track traffic, latency, and error rates, and maintain control over their brand identity, such as their verified logos and authenticated accounts. items.fullText: Pioneers Across Europe Deploy NVIDIA Earth-2 Open Models to Power Real-World Weather and Climate Prediction October 21, 2026 by Niall Robinson 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Weather forecasts shape more than daily plans; timely weather information is crucial for energy producers, insurers and transport operators to plan around changing conditions. A global forecast can show a storm taking shape, but decisions about solar farms, shipping routes or insured property depend on what happens locally. NVIDIA Earth-2 gives developers and researchers a family of open AI models and tools they can customize with their own data. Running on NVIDIA computing, these technologies support global weather prediction, detailed regional forecasts and environmental research. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements StormScope EU is the latest model to join Earth-2 — a regional version of the StormScope model for short-term forecasting, trained over Europe weather and climate data. It uses EUMETSAT satellite observations to predict evolving cloud conditions across 16 Meteosat channels at 10-minute intervals. At GTC Berlin, NVIDIA is showcasing a live StormScope EU pipeline in an interactive weather demo built in partnership with Earthmover . The demo uses Earth2Studio to run forecasts and Earthmover’s data platform to manage and serve the real-time results, which are updated as soon as new satellite observations come in, every 10 minutes. Earthmover serves these results as map tiles, letting visitors explore predictions across Europe without downloading entire datasets. Developers can combine Earth-2 models in workflows tailored to regional needs, using StormScope for short-term forecasting and CorrDiff to add local detail to coarser weather data.
